options.name: DefaultPort
options.description: Default starting port for player data. If UDP, this is this one of two ports used.

options.name: PublicName
options.description: Name of the server displayed in the in-game browser and, if applicable, the Steam browser

options.name: PublicDescription
options.description: Description displayed in the in-game public server browser. Typing \n will create a new line in your description

options.name: Public
options.description: Shows the server on the in-game browser. (Note: Steam-enabled servers are always visible in the Steam server browser)

options.name: Password
options.description: Clients must know this password to join the server. (Ignored when hosting a server via the Host button)

options.name: PauseEmpty
options.description: Game time stops when there are no players online

options.name: ResetID
options.warning: Changing it makes every player create a new character (soft reset).
options.description: Reset ID determines if the server has undergone a soft-reset. If this number does match the client, the client must create a new character. Used in conjunction with PlayerServerID. It is strongly advised that you backup these IDs somewhere

options.name: MaxAccountsPerUser
options.description: Limits the number of different accounts a single Steam user may create on this server. Ignored when using the Hosts button.

options.name: SteamScoreboard
options.description: Show Steam usernames and avatars in the Players list.

options.name: MaxPlayers
options.description:
Maximum number of players that can be on the server at one time. This excludes admins.
WARNING: Server player counts above 32 will potentially result in poor map streaming and desync. Please advance with caution.

options.name: Open
options.description: Clients may join without already having an account in the whitelist. If set to false, administrators must manually create username/password combos.

options.name: DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath
options.description: Remove player accounts from the whitelist after death. This prevents players creating a new character after death on Open=false servers

options.name: DisplayUserName
options.description: Display usernames above player's heads in-game.

options.name: ShowFirstAndLastName
options.description: Display first & last name above player's heads.

options.name: SpawnItems
options.description:
Item types new players spawn with.
Separate multiple item types with commas.
Example: Base.Axe,Base.Bag_BigHikingBag

options.name: PingLimit
options.description: Ping limit, in milliseconds, before a player is kicked from the server. (Set to 0 to disable)

options.name: ServerPlayerID
options.warning: Changing it makes every player create a new character (soft reset).
options.description: ServerPlayerID determines if a character is from another server, or single player. This value may be changed by soft resets. If this number does match the client, the client must create a new character. This is used in conjunction with ResetID. It is strongly advised that you backup these IDs somewhere

options.name: SleepAllowed
options.description: Players are allowed to sleep when their survivor becomes tired, but they do not NEED to sleep

options.name: SleepNeeded
options.description: Players get tired and need to sleep. (Ignored if SleepAllowed=false)

options.name: PlayerRespawnWithSelf
options.description: Players can respawn in-game at the coordinates where they died

options.name: PlayerRespawnWithOther
options.description: Players can respawn in-game at a split screen / Remote Play player's location

options.name: RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval
options.description: If enabled, when HoursForCorpseRemoval triggers, it will also remove player's corpses from the ground.

options.name: TrashDeleteAll
options.description: If true, player can use the "delete all" button on bins.

options.name: PVPMeleeWhileHitReaction
options.description: If true, player can hit again when struck by another player.

options.name: MouseOverToSeeDisplayName
options.description: If true, players will have to mouse over someone to see their display name.

options.name: HidePlayersBehindYou
options.description: If true, automatically hide the player you can't see (like zombies).

options.name: PlayerBumpPlayer
options.description: Governs whether players bump (and knock over) other players when running through them.

options.name: MapRemotePlayerVisibility
options.description:
Controls display of remote players on the in-game map.
1=Hidden 2=Friends 3=Friends and nearby players 4=Everyone

options.name: AllowCoop
options.description: Allow co-op/splitscreen players

options.name: ClientCommandFilter
options.description:
Semicolon-separated list of commands that will not be written to the cmd.txt server log. For example: 
-vehicle. Inputting * means do NOT write any vehicle command. Inputting: 
+vehicle.installPart means DO write that command

options.name: ClientActionLogs
options.description: Semicolon-separated list of actions that will be written to the ClientActionLogs.txt server log.

options.name: PerkLogs
options.description: Track changes in player perk levels in PerkLog.txt server log

options.name: DisableRadioStaff
options.description: Disables radio transmissions from players with an access level

options.name: DisableRadioAdmin
options.description: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'admin' access level

options.name: DisableRadioGM
options.description: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'gm' access level

options.name: DisableRadioOverseer
options.description: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'overseer' access level

options.name: DisableRadioModerator
options.description: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'moderator' access level

options.name: DisableRadioInvisible
options.description: Disables radio transmissions from invisible players

options.name: NoFire
options.description: All forms of fire are disabled - except for campfires

options.name: PVP
options.description: Players can hurt and kill other players

options.name: SafetySystem
options.description: Players can enter and leave PVP on an individual basis. A player can only hurt another player when at least one of them is in PVP mode - as shown by the unobscured skull and crossbones on the left of the screen. When SafetySystem=false, players are free to hurt each other at any time if PVP is enabled.

options.name: ShowSafety
options.description: Display a skull icon over the head of players who have entered PVP mode

options.name: SafetyToggleTimer
options.description: The time it takes for a player to enter and leave PVP mode

options.name: SafetyCooldownTimer
options.description: The delay before a player can enter or leave PVP mode again, having recently done so

options.name: PVPMeleeDamageModifier
options.description: Damage multiplier for PVP melee attacks.

options.name: PVPFirearmDamageModifier
options.description: Damage multiplier for PVP ranged attacks.

options.name: PVPLogToolChat
options.description: PVP is logged to admin chat

options.name: PVPLogToolFile
options.description: PVP is logged to file

options.name: SafehousePreventsLootRespawn
options.description: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have claimed as a safehouse

options.name: ItemNumbersLimitPerContainer
options.description: Maximum number of items that can be placed in a container.  Zero means there is no limit. (PLEASE NOTE: This includes individual small items such as nails. A limit of 50 will mean only 50 nails can be stored.)

options.name: WarStartDelay
options.description: Time in seconds before the war starts.

options.name: WarDuration
options.description: War duration in seconds.

options.name: WarSafehouseHitPoints
options.description: Safehouse hit points limit.

options.name: Faction
options.description: Players can create factions when true

options.name: FactionDaySurvivedToCreate
options.description: Players must survive this number of in-game days before being allowed to create a faction

options.name: FactionPlayersRequiredForTag
options.description: Number of players required as faction members before the faction owner can create a group tag

options.name: AdminSafehouse
options.description: Only admins can claim safehouses

options.name: PlayerSafehouse
options.description: Both admins and players can claim safehouses

options.name: SafehouseAllowTrepass
options.description: Allow non-members to enter a safehouse without being invited

options.name: SafehouseAllowFire
options.description: Allow fire to damage safehouses

options.name: SafehouseAllowLoot
options.description: Allow non-members to take items from safehouses

options.name: SafehouseAllowRespawn
options.description: Players will respawn in a safehouse that they were a member of before they died

options.name: SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim
options.description: Players must have survived this number of in-game days before they are allowed to claim a safehouse

options.name: SafeHouseRemovalTime
options.description: Players are automatically removed from a safehouse they have not visited for this many real-world hours

options.name: DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected
options.description: Safehouse acts like a normal house if an owner of the safehouse is connected (so secure when the owner is offline)

options.name: SafehouseAllowNonResidential
options.description: Governs whether players can claim non-residential buildings.

options.name: GlobalChat
options.description: Toggles global chat on or off.

options.name: AnnounceDeath
options.description: If checked, every time a player dies a global message will be displayed in the chat

options.name: AnnounceAnimalDeath
options.description: If checked, every time an animal dies a global message will be displayed in the chat

options.name: ServerWelcomeMessage
options.default: Welcome to Project Zomboid Multiplayer! <LINE> <LINE> To interact with the Chat panel: press Tab, T, or Enter. <LINE> <LINE> The Tab key will change the target stream of the message. <LINE> <LINE> Global Streams: /all <LINE> Local Streams: /say, /yell <LINE> Special Steams: /whisper, /safehouse, /faction. <LINE> <LINE> Press the Up arrow to cycle through your message history. Click the Gear icon to customize chat. <LINE> <LINE> Happy surviving!
options.description: The first welcome message visible in the chat panel. This will be displayed immediately after player login. you can use RGB colours to chance the colour of the welcome message. You can also use < LINE>, without the space, to create a separate lines within your text. Use: \<RGB:1,0,0> This message will show up red!

options.name: BadWordListFile
options.description: Path to the file with the list of words to be prohibited. Each word must be on a separate line

options.name: BadWordPolicy
options.description: What to do with the sender of a bad word in the chat: 1 - ban, 2 - kick, 3 - record the violation in the database, 4 - mute

options.name: BadWordReplacement
options.description: The symbol or piece of text that will replace the bad word

options.name: GoodWordListFile
options.description: Path to the file with the list of words that should be allowed, even if they contain bad word. Each word should be on a separate line.

options.name: RCONPort
options.description: The port for the RCON (Remote Console)

options.name: RCONPassword
options.description: RCON password (Pick a strong password)

options.name: DiscordEnable
options.description: Enables global text chat integration with a Discord channel

options.name: DiscordToken
options.description: Discord bot access token

options.name: DiscordChatChannel
options.description: The Discord chat channel name

options.name: DiscordLogChannel
options.description: The Discord logs channel name

options.name: DiscordCommandChannel
options.description: The Discord commands channel name

options.name: UPnP
options.description: Attempt to configure a UPnP-enabled internet gateway to automatically setup port forwarding rules. The server will fall back to default ports if this fails

options.name: CarEngineAttractionModifier
options.description: Modify the range of zombie attraction to cars. (Lower values can help with lag.)

options.name: DisableBurntTowing
options.description: Disables burnt vehicle towing

options.name: DisableTrailerTowing
options.description: Disables trailer towing

options.name: DisableVehicleTowing
options.description: Disables vehicle towing

options.name: VoiceEnable
options.description: VOIP is enabled when checked

options.name: VoiceMinDistance
options.description: The minimum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard.

options.name: VoiceMaxDistance
options.description: The maximum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard.

options.name: Voice3D
options.description: Toggle directional audio for VOIP

options.name: AntiCheatChecksum
options.description: Disables checksum anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatHit
options.description: Disables character hit anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatNoClip
options.description: Disables character no-clipping anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatPacketException
options.description: Disables packet exception checks anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatPermission
options.description: Disables player permissions anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatPlayer
options.description: Disables player anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatSafeHouse
options.description: Disables safehouse anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatSafety
options.description: Disables safety system anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatSpeed
options.description: Disables character speed anti-cheat protection.

options.name: AntiCheatXP
options.description: Disables player XP anti-cheat protection.

options.name: MaxPacketsPerSecond
options.description: Sets the limit for processing network packets from each client on the server.

options.name: SteamVAC
options.description: Enable the Steam VAC system

options.name: Map
options.description: Enter the foldername of the mod found in \Steam\steamapps\workshop\modID\mods\modName\media\maps\

options.name: Mods
options.description: Enter the mod loading ID here. It can be found in \Steam\steamapps\workshop\modID\mods\modName\info.txt

options.name: Seed
options.warning: Changing it changes how new parts of the map are generated; it is unique to this world.
options.description:
The worldgen seed used to generate the world.
If you want to change this, put a new value in and delete map_worldgen.bin in your save directory.

options.name: SpawnPoint
options.description: Force every new player to spawn at these set x,y,z world coordinates. Find desired coordinates at map.projectzomboid.com. (Ignored when 0,0,0)

options.name: WorkshopItems
options.description: List Workshop Mod IDs for the server to download. Each must be separated by a semicolon. Example: WorkshopItems=514427485;513111049

options.name: DoLuaChecksum
options.description: Kick clients whose game files don't match the server's.

options.name: AllowDestructionBySledgehammer
options.description: Allow players to destroy world objects with sledgehammers

options.name: SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse
options.description: Allow players to destroy world objects only in their safehouse (require AllowDestructionBySledgehammer to true).

options.name: SaveWorldEveryMinutes
options.description: Loaded parts of the map are saved after this set number of real-world minutes have passed. (The map is usually saved only after clients leave a loaded area)

options.name: FastForwardMultiplier
options.description: Governs how fast time passes while players sleep. Value multiplies the speed of the time that passes during sleeping.

options.name: AllowNonAsciiUsername
options.description: Allow use of non-ASCII (cyrillic etc) characters in usernames

options.name: BloodSplatLifespanDays
options.description:
Number of days before old blood splats are removed.
Removal happens when map chunks are loaded.
Zero means they will never disappear

options.name: DisableScoreboard
options.description: Disables scoreboard.

options.name: HideAdminsInPlayerList
options.description: Hides admins in the player list.

options.name: KnockedDownAllowed
options.description: WIP: Activating this setting may cause visual desynchronization of player positions.

options.name: MultiplayerStatisticsPeriod
options.description: Sets the multiplayer update period in seconds. Statistics is disabled if value is 0.

options.name: server_browser_announced_ip
options.description: Set the IP from which the server is broadcast. This is for network configurations with multiple IP addresses, such as server farms

options.name: ShowCoordinates
options.description: Shows player character coordinates in the lower right corner.

options.name: WebhookAddress
options.description: The Slack incoming webhook URL
